subject: Air freight quote request: FRA to PEK
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from Frankfurt Airport (FRA) to Beijing (PEK), China? We will deliver the shipment to FRA ourselves, and it will be ready on 2026-11-27.

The shipment consists of 9 pieces of textile samples, with a gross weight of 700 kg and a total volume of 6.58 cbm.

Please provide your all-in price in EUR and confirm the earliest available departure and expected arrival at PEK.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specified shipment from FRA to PEK.
